$Comment: Christmas Day lifts XP in every skill for everyone on the server, on a server running MMO Skill Tree.
Only that mod reads this folder, so without it the file is never loaded.
A boost rule is a standing boost: nobody activates it and it has no timer. It applies to every XP award
in the skills it names while its Requires passes, and it counts as a global boost, so the server's stack
mode and multiplier cap in skill-config.json bound it like any other, the Christmas trades boost
Skills all is every skill. Multiplier 1.25 is a quarter more. ziggfreedcommon:calendar_live reads 1 only
while that calendar event runs, so this rule needs both Christmas and its one-day event Christmas_Day
(December 25th) running. Text.TitleKey names it on the boosts pages; its words are in
christmas.mmo.lang. To change or switch it off, ship a file with this same name in a pack of your own
